about: Witness mutants for repl_send_battery.sh --prove-red. Each plants ONE named defect in a throwaway copy of the nvim tree (`find` must occur exactly once in `file`); every `reds` case must go FAIL and every `control` case must stay PASS. Anchors track the slime (bracketed-paste) path: re-anchor them when that code moves.

mutants.what: multi-line body-only blocks are no longer shifted left (outer_dedent skipped)
a complete block no longer ends with the execution CR
blank lines are dropped again (the regression ruling 2026-10-02 forbids)
mutants.replace:
lines = remove_empty_lines(lines)
  local shift = target and held[target]

mutants.what: a cell is never seen as continued by a deeper next cell (nothing is held)
mutants.find: return deeper ~= nil and deeper > base

mutants.what: the block that continues a held cell is shifted by its own first line, not by the held cell's shift
mutants.find:
if shift then
    out = strip_prefix(lines, shift)
mutants.replace:
if false then
    out = strip_prefix(lines, shift)

mutants.what: an indented `# %%` is no longer a cell boundary (column-0 markers only)
held paste goes through vim-slime newline promotion and executes before its continuation
mutants.replace: if true or vim.bo.filetype ~= "python" or not cell_continues_next
